HowItWorks_STEPS.title: Complete the free assessment
HowItWorks_STEPS.body: Answer a short set of questions about your connection to the UAE, your family and the general nature of your assets. No account is needed and no payment is taken.

HowItWorks_STEPS.title: Receive your preliminary result
HowItWorks_STEPS.body: The result indicates whether your circumstances may suit the standard online pathway, or whether the legal team should review the matter first.
HowItWorks_STEPS.note: The result is preliminary guidance. It is not a legal opinion and it is not a decision by any registration authority.

HowItWorks_STEPS.title: Create your account and accept the engagement terms
HowItWorks_STEPS.body: You are shown the proposed service, the professional fee and VAT, what the fee includes, the amendment allowance, known exclusions and the separate charge categories before you commit to anything.

HowItWorks_STEPS.title: Pay the professional fee
HowItWorks_STEPS.body: AED {fee} plus VAT for one accepted standard Will. Payment starts the work; it does not register a Will and it is not an acceptance by any authority.

HowItWorks_STEPS.title: Complete the detailed questionnaire
HowItWorks_STEPS.body: Beneficiaries, executors, guardianship wishes where the route permits, assets and any existing documents. You can save and return; the questionnaire adapts to your answers.

HowItWorks_STEPS.title: Upload your documents
HowItWorks_STEPS.body: Passport, Emirates ID and any document relevant to the accepted scope. On a phone you can photograph them directly.

HowItWorks_STEPS.title: Human legal review and drafting
HowItWorks_STEPS.body: A legal professional reviews your instructions, confirms the appropriate wording and the recommended registration route, and prepares your draft.
HowItWorks_STEPS.note: Every Will receives human legal review before it is treated as ready for your approval. There is no exception, and no automated draft is released.

HowItWorks_STEPS.title: Review, amend and approve
HowItWorks_STEPS.body: You read the draft, request the amendments included in your service and personally approve the final wording. Nothing is submitted anywhere until you have approved it.

HowItWorks_STEPS.title: Registration preparation and submission
HowItWorks_STEPS.body: We prepare and submit the application and explain the authority's requirements and its charge before you authorise payment to it. Identity verification, signing and attendance remain personal steps, and the authority completes registration under its current rules.

WillOptions_ROUTES.name: DIFC Courts Wills Service
WillOptions_ROUTES.who: A person who is not Muslim and has never been Muslim, is at least 18 years old, and has qualifying UAE assets and/or qualifying minor children under the applicable guardianship requirements
WillOptions_ROUTES.features: Specialist DIFC rules; its general FAQ lists five standard Will types and its service page also presents a Digital Assets Will option; virtual registration is currently available; UAE residence is not required
WillOptions_ROUTES.handled: Direct contact with Summit before payment where DIFC is identified at assessment; engagements start from AED 3,999 plus VAT

WillOptions_ROUTES.name: ADJD Civil Wills
WillOptions_ROUTES.who: A person who is not a UAE citizen; ADJD states that religion does not prevent access to its Civil Wills Office
WillOptions_ROUTES.features: ADJD Civil Wills Section; standard bilingual template and special or customised registration routes are available under its current process
WillOptions_ROUTES.handled: Standard online pathway — AED {fee} plus VAT, reviewed by Summit's legal team after payment

WillOptions_ROUTES.name: Dubai Courts Wills
WillOptions_ROUTES.who: Non-Muslim testators whose Will and estate fall within UAE's statutory framework
WillOptions_ROUTES.features: Dubai Law No. 15 of 2017 establishes a Dubai Courts register for non-Muslim Wills and rules on registration, implementation and estate administration
WillOptions_ROUTES.handled: Standard online pathway — AED {fee} plus VAT, reviewed by Summit's legal team after payment

WillOptions_ROUTES.name: Muslim Will pathway
WillOptions_ROUTES.who: Muslim residents, investors or asset owners who wish to make a Will within the rules applicable to them
WillOptions_ROUTES.features: May record permitted gifts and appointments under the applicable Personal Status framework; ADJD registration may be available to a person who is not a UAE citizen
WillOptions_ROUTES.handled: Standard online pathway — Muslim clients pay and complete the questionnaire like any other client, and Summit's legal team applies the applicable rules during review

WillOptions_ROUTES.name: Foreign Will involving UAE assets
WillOptions_ROUTES.who: A person who has or plans a Will in another country
WillOptions_ROUTES.features: May remain relevant and form part of a coordinated international estate plan
WillOptions_ROUTES.handled: Standard online pathway, reviewed alongside the existing document
